description: Source code for a Wear OS watch face service that displays time and daily step count via Google Fit API.

classes.name: FitStepsWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class for the watch face, extending CanvasWatchFaceService.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, handling drawing, Google Fit integration, and watch face lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face, sets up GoogleApiClient, paints, and resources.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles registration of receivers and GoogleApiClient connection based on visibility.

methods.name: onApplyWindowInsets
methods.description: Adjusts layout and text sizes for round or square screens.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Adjusts anti-aliasing and typeface based on device properties.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Updates step count and redraws the watch face periodically.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws time and step count on the canvas.

methods.name: getTotalSteps
methods.description: Requests total step count from Google Fit API.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connects; subscribes to step data and fetches total steps.

methods.name: subscribeToSteps
methods.description: Subscribes to step count updates via Google Fit.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the daily total step count query.
